parsed.post: Discarding the LR=0.055 experiment (1.0515 vs 1.0463). It appears my current depth 4 configuration is sensitive to even small LR increases. Reverting to 4952c54. I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if a slightly larger model can stabilize these higher learning rates better.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 while keeping LR=0.05 to see if increased capacity improves stability and convergence within the 5-minute budget.
